1.consolidated_definition: inform. Novela o relato dividido en porciones donde se narra en tiempo real la peripecia vital de un personaje que habla en primera persona. Neologismo anglicado, poco frecuente. Se ha acuñado incluso el término blogonovela ¿Habrá blogopoesía? (El Nuevo Día, 11-11-07)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Informal term. Novel or narrative divided into portions where the life story of a character speaking in first person is told in real time. Anglicized neologism, relatively uncommon. The term blognovel has even been coined; will there be blogpoetry? (The New Day, 11-11-07)
